a caregiver adds, edits, deletes when allowed (US-41, US-46) · "Added by", "Edited by"
The form doesn't use HospitalField yet: searching a hospital there is planned. A caregiver sees the patient's appointment read-only
when the patient shares Planning (ObserveCareSection), and adds, edits or deletes one for them when allowed, signed with CaregiverName (US-41, US-46).
The summary only counts and lists the symptoms the patient logged, shown on screen; no sharing or PDF export (US-47).
It opens from the appointment detail or the symptom journal, for a period the patient picks (since the last appointment by default).
US-48 also opens it from an Overview card, from 1 hour before to 2 hours after the appointment starts (see Planning and Overview),
and from the "Open symptoms summary" action of the appointment reminder (see Reminders).
